jobs.excerpt: About RemoteRemote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease.
jobs.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
  • Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
  • Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
  • Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: APAC

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Take Home Exercise
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  5. Interview with Senior Manager
  6. Bar Raiser
  7. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$46,500—$117,750 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Position Summary

The Epic Products Analyst, Senior applies advanced knowledge of healthcare operations and information technology principles to provide multifaceted direct Epic application support across the Epic software development life cycle for the design, development, implementation, testing, updating, integration, and maintenance of complex system configuration, system setup, and application tables by analyzing user, system, and application needs, and evaluating multiple alternative approaches to determine the best solution to meet the needs of the organization

Essential Functions

  • Assists with and coordinates the effort in change processes, content governance, and prioritization; implements approved new development, system enhancements, and releases
  • Troubleshoots problems and responds to questions received from the Service Desk and end users in a timely manner

  • Provides consulting support to Business Relationship Management teams to analyze business operations, investigate end-user preferences, and incorporate informatics best practices when making build decisions
  • Creates security classification templates to provide the appropriate level of access, while ensuring the protection of patient health information

  • Monitors and collaborates with stakeholders during the integration of interfaced applications to ensure that the build and maintenance of the system and patient data integrity are not negatively impacted

  • Ensures interoperability between Epic applications and other supporting applications
  • Communicates with vendors regarding technical issues with Epic integration
  • Utilizes understanding of IT trends and the practical application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models related to the Epic software

  • Analyzes the business-IT environment (run, grow, and transform the business) to detect critical deficiencies and recommend solutions for improvement, differentiation, and innovation
  • Maintains reasonably regular, punctual attendance consistent with Baptist Health policies, the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards
  • Maintains compliance with all Baptist Health policies and procedures

Other Related Functions

  • Solves unique problems within the Epic application that have a broad impact on the associated business functions and require conceptual and innovative thinking to develop solutions
  • Provides remote end-user support, including participation in on-call service rotations
  • Performs other duties as assigned

  • and two (2) years of directly related work experience may substitute for the Bachelor’s degree
  • or equivalent and four (4) years of directly related work experience may also substitute for the Bachelor’s degree

  • Epic certification in the primary build application is required within six (6) months of appointment and must be maintained

Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in an information technology field

jobs.title: Group Product Owner, Solution Innovation & Design
jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Group Product Owner – Solution Innovation is responsible for defining the long-term vision, strategy, and execution priorities for a product group focused on rapid solution innovation for Community Pharmacy Solutions (CPS). Reporting to the VP, Solution Development and Innovation, this role owns the innovation backlog and sets priorities for a high-velocity Solution Innovation team that supports net-new solution incubation, targeted enhancements to existing solutions, and digital marketing enablement capabilities that support pharmacy growth and customer engagement.

This role also provides oversight and strategic alignment for the digital marketing enablement function led by the Director – Digital Marketing Enablement. This includes ensuring that digital marketing tools, pharmacy-facing digital platforms, vendor-enabled marketing capabilities, digital analytics, Google advertising and listing capabilities, MyGNP digital properties, CRM-enabled workflows, and related customer engagement platforms are aligned to CPS product development and innovation priorities.

The GPO ensures innovation work is customer-centered, aligned to CPS strategy, and delivered through disciplined product management practices. The role partners with peer Group Product Owners and cross-functional stakeholders to translate market problems into validated opportunities, execute proof-of-concepts and pilots, coordinate digital solution experimentation, and move successful innovations into formal product roadmaps for commercialization and adoption.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Innovation Strategy, Pipeline, and Prioritization

  • Define and drive the innovation strategy, business plan, and growth themes for the Solution Innovation product group aligned to CPS objectives.

  • Maintain and prioritize an innovation backlog of ideas, prototypes, digital capabilities, and enhancements; make trade-off decisions based on customer value, feasibility, strategic impact, and readiness to scale.

  • Continuously evaluate and quantify market demand, define opportunities, and identify product/market fit for innovation concepts across CPS solutions and digital marketing enablement capabilities.

  • Ensure the digital marketing enablement roadmap and associated platform priorities are integrated into the broader Solution Innovation pipeline where they support CPS growth, customer engagement, and pharmacy enablement.

Oversight of Digital Marketing Enablement

  • Provide strategic oversight to the Director – Digital Marketing Enablement and their team to ensure digital marketing tools, vendor capabilities, customer-facing digital properties, platform enhancements, and digital analytics support CPS strategy and innovation priorities.

  • Ensure digital marketing enablement work—including Google advertising, Google Business Profiles, My GNP Mobile app, MyGNP.com, social media enablement, Salesforce-enabled workflows, analytics, vendor management, and product marketing—is aligned to CPS product development and innovation processes.

  • Guide prioritization of digital marketing enhancement requests, platform capabilities, pilots, and customer experience improvements so they are evaluated through a consistent product and innovation lens.

  • Ensure digital marketing enablement capabilities provide actionable insights, scalable customer engagement tools, and reliable inputs into broader CPS solution development and commercialization planning.

Solution Discovery, Prototyping, and Proof of Concept

  • Lead discovery to translate customer needs, digital engagement opportunities, and market problems into use cases, hypotheses, requirements, and minimum viable experiments.

  • Direct execution of proof-of-concepts, beta tests, digital pilots, and prototypes through the Solution Innovation developer pod and digital marketing enablement team where applicable.

  • Establish measurable success criteria for experiments and pilots; recommend whether to stop, iterate, scale, or transition work into the appropriate product or platform roadmap.

  • Ensure lessons learned from digital marketing pilots, customer utilization patterns, analytics, and vendor-enabled capabilities inform the broader product development and innovation process.

Product Ownership and Agile Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end success of innovation capabilities from requirements definition through design, development, launch authorization, and post-launch analysis.

  • Partner with UX/design, digital marketing enablement, commercial, product, and operations teams to ensure voice of customer informs requirements and solution designs.

  • Ensure the Solution Innovation pod and digital enablement delivery teams operate with clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and measurable outcomes.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies, resource conflicts, platform constraints, vendor dependencies, and risks; develop mitigation plans and manage issue resolution.

Team Leadership and Operating Model

  • Set priorities, sprint goals, and deliverable expectations for the Solution Innovation developer pod and ensure appropriate alignment with the Director – Digital Marketing Enablement and their team.

  • Create clear operating rhythms between innovation development, digital marketing enablement, product teams, commercialization, brand, and solution enablement stakeholders.

  • Establish sustainable processes and lightweight standards for rapid innovation, including documentation, privacy/security considerations, reusability, compliance review, vendor evaluation, and transition-to-scale artifacts.

  • Foster a culture of continuous testing and learning, encouraging smart risk-taking, customer-centered design, and iterative delivery.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Transition to Scale

  • Partner closely with other Group Product Owners to provide innovation capacity, prototyping support, and digital enablement insight for their domains.

  • Coordinate with Commercialization, Brand Management, Engagement, Solution Enablement, and Adoption leaders to ensure validated innovations transition with clear positioning, launch readiness inputs, training considerations, and adoption plans.

  • Develop and require transition artifacts such as problem statements, VOC insights, business case assumptions, pilot results, technical approach, vendor implications, digital analytics, and support model requirements.

  • Ensure digital marketing enablement initiatives that move beyond experimentation are transitioned into clear ownership, support, operating processes, and measurable performance management.

Portfolio Health, Metrics, and Performance

  • Define and track innovation KPIs including throughput, concept-to-prototype cycle time, experiment success rate, adoption indicators, digital engagement metrics, and business value impact.

  • Monitor health of the innovation portfolio including adoption, customer value, technical and operational performance, quality, financial impacts, and digital enablement performance.

  • Provide regular updates to leadership on innovation and digital enablement progress and recommend adjustments to priorities, pace, resourcing, or governance.

  • Use digital marketing analytics, customer utilization, field feedback, and vendor performance reporting to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, pilots, and customer engagement improvements.

Compliance and Other

  • Ensure all innovation and digital enablement work complies with applicable policies, procedures, privacy, security, accessibility, and relevant legal/regulatory standards.

  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, solution development, innovation, digital enablement, marketing technology, healthcare, pharmacy, or technology-enabled services.

  • Demonstrated experience leading proof-of-concepts, pilots, beta testing, rapid iteration, or digital platform enhancements within a product or agile delivery environment.

  • Experience overseeing or partnering closely with digital marketing, marketing technology, analytics, vendor management, or customer engagement platform teams preferred.

  • Experience leading small, high-velocity technical teams and cross-functional teams, including offshore or vendor-supported resources, preferred.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge, and Ability Requirements

  • Strong product management discipline, including product vision, roadmap management, backlog prioritization, requirements definition, and outcome measurement.

  • Strong understanding of innovation methods, rapid experimentation, proof-of-concept design, pilot governance, and transition-to-scale practices.

  • Ability to translate customer problems, digital engagement needs, and market opportunities into clear product requirements and prioritized execution plans.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with ability to influence product, technology, marketing, commercialization, operations, vendor, and executive stakeholders.

  • Ability to evaluate customer value, technical feasibility, operational readiness, financial impact, and strategic fit when prioritizing innovation work.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex concepts into executive-ready recommendations.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use KPIs, VOC, digital analytics, adoption data, and financial indicators to guide decisions.

  • Knowledge of pharmacy services, digital marketing enablement, customer engagement platforms, and healthcare technology preferred.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a critical member of the Customer Experience Strategy team, you will focus on advancing our mission of delivering a superior experience throughout the customers' end-to-end journey. You will play a pivotal role in improving our customers' experience, loyalty and growth by influencing the company and our leadership to action using customer experience feedback and insights, increasingly powered by AI-driven signal analysis. This role reports directly to the Head of CX Strategy.

You have extensive voice of the customer (VoC) program management experience and are passionate about customer data, with a proven history of driving insights that improve the customer experience. You understand that AI is changing how companies listen to, understand, and act on customer feedback, and you're excited to bring that thinking into how we run our listening programs. You will partner with leaders across the organization to execute new customer listening programs and provide a more holistic, increasingly real-time voice of customer assessment for Samsara.

You'll come with a strong understanding of customer experience program management, analytics, and the ability to tell compelling stories with data. You will also come ready to dive deep into customer journeys and data — using both traditional analysis including customer visits and interviews, and emerging AI tools like LLM-based theme extraction and AI-inferred sentiment analysis — to understand and empathize with customer pain points and identify opportunities with respect to customer engagement, business strategy, and quality of service.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Build a world-class customer listening infrastructure. Design and lead new and emerging Voice of Customer (VoC) programs — NPS, CSAT, CES, transactional and relationship surveys as well as customer interviews — that give the organization actionable customer experience insights. Use AI to help move beyond periodic snapshots toward more continuous, real-time, customer sentiment. This includes survey design and operations, reporting, analysis, and managing a robust closed loop process.
  • Derive rich insights from quant and qual customer data. Go beyond top-line reporting — dig deep to uncover key drivers, surface less obvious trends, and business/customer-health impact.
  • Drive systemic customer experience improvements. Facilitate cross-functional insight reviews and action-planning meetings with internal stakeholders to drive customer experience improvements. Lead efforts targeting key customer pain points to optimize the customer experience, working cross-functionally to integrate quantitative and qualitative feedback to determine, design and implement strategic solutions.
  • Help evaluate and pilot AI tooling for CX intelligence, from automated insight-delivery platforms to AI-moderated research tools, partnering with the team to balance innovation with data quality and security.
  • Operationalize a customer-centric culture at Samsara. Inspire the organization to listen, understand and act on customer feedback as an effective data-driven storyteller.
  • Be a CX and AI thought leader. Bring industry leading trends, technologies, and best practices — including emerging AI applications in customer intelligence — to Samsara to continually stay best in class on customer experience programs and approaches.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years direct experience in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Partner Experience, or Market Research in a B2B SaaS or Fortune 500 Company.
  • Travel: Comfort traveling to customer sites 2-3 times/quarter (1-2 days per trip) to gain first-hand understanding of customer operations.
  • Experience managing global customer or partner listening posts, such as NPS programs, advisory boards, transactional survey programs, or event-based surveys.
  • Knowledge of a variety of survey design and research methods.
  • Experience in analyzing and interpreting a mix of qualitative and quantitative data, constructing compelling narratives, and providing recommendations on complex topics. Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills; deep sense of curiosity.
  • Strong presentation skills, able to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner both verbally and in writing, comfortable in business and technical discussions. Ability to synthesize a broad set of information into a cohesive narrative.
  • Experience applying statistical techniques and working knowledge of statistics concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to customer understanding — such as LLM-based theme extraction, AI-inferred sentiment analysis, AI-moderated research, or AI-augmented VoC programs.
  • Experience in building trusting relationships and influencing others (including executive audiences).
  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience using Qualtrics, Medallia, or similar enterprise-level experience management platforms.
  • Experience using R programming or Stata for statistical analysis on customer experience data.
  • Experience running churn and predictive models based on customer experience data.
  • Exposure to AI-moderated research tools or automated insight/reporting platforms.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

Founded in 2018 with co-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results.

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it’s popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security-focused teams.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in MST or PST.

About the Role

You'll join as a founding member of Tines’ forward deployed team, embedded directly with our most strategic enterprise customers to drive transformational AI adoption. Your job is to realize maximum potential for Tines’ customers and to ensure every stakeholder from end user to customer leadership understands and fully realizes the value of Tines.

You own the full arc of a customer's success: from deepening adoption and enabling stakeholders through to discovering new opportunities where the platform can create measurable business impact. You’ll show customers the art of what's possible and ensuring the value delivered today is only the beginning. You'll be the person customers trust most to make the Tines’ platform work for them in practice.

We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity and represent us at the highest level inside customer environments. You'll be as comfortable deep in a customer's technical environment as you are leading a training session with a non-technical team or presenting a business case to a CTO.

What you will be doing:

  • Own end-to-end deployment: Lead the technical implementation of Tines’ platform within complex enterprise environments. Integrating with existing systems, configuring for customer-specific workflows and ensuring a fast, smooth path to deliverable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption across the organisation: Proactively support and train users and stakeholders in the customer at every level from hands-on technical teams to business leaders ensuring the platform is understood actively used and maximized.
  • Identify and develop new use cases: Through deep familiarity with each customer's business, continuously surface new opportunities where Tines’ platform can create additional value expanding adoption across teams, workflows, and business units.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact: Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on all things platform-related. Troubleshooting issues, delivering workshops, answering technical questions and resolving blockers before they become problems.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships: Build lasting partnerships at every level of the organisation, from daily users to executive sponsors with a focus on long-term retention and growth.
  • Feed insights back to the product: Codify what you learn in the field. Surfacing recurring friction points, unmet needs and high-value use cases and sharing these with Tines’ internal teams such as Engineering, Product and GTM.
  • Travel 20–40% to customer sites to build trust, accelerate adoption and deepen relationships in person.

What you Bring with you:

  • 8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: Solutions / Pre-sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Customer Success Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration / Implementation Engineer or Software Engineer with customer exposure
  • Proven track record of driving adoption and delivering measurable value from complex technical products inside enterprise environments
  • Strong engineering skills to own integrations, troubleshoot production issues and understand customer infrastructure
  • Strong Python skills (plus ideally TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Production experience with LLMs and AI systems: prompt engineering, agent workflows, and deployment at scale
  • Ability to train, enable and influence stakeholders across all levels
  • High agency and resourcefulness: you find a path forward independently, escalate only when necessary, and take full ownership of your accounts
  • Strong communication skills: clear, confident, and low-ego: you make complex things feel simple
  • Willingness to travel 20–40% to customer sites

Target Annual Compensation: $230K-280K OTE

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

  • Reactor systems design and performance evaluation
  • Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and/or system codes used in reactor analysis

jobs.description:
About the role

The Solution Architect – Fiber & Structured Cabling, AI Data Center is a customer-facing technical role responsible for designing and architecting high-density fiber and structured cabling solutions for large-scale AI data center environments. The role works closely with customers, Solution Specialists, Account Executives, engineering, Professional Services, OEMs, manufacturers, and delivery teams to translate AI infrastructure requirements into scalable, repeatable, and executable physical connectivity designs. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data center fiber infrastructure and understands the unique density, speed, scale, quality, and deployment requirements associated with GPU clusters, high-performance networks, and hyperscale AI environments.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture for fiber and structured cabling solutions supporting AI data center programs.
  • Translate customer compute, network, rack, and deployment requirements into physical layer designs, standards, BOMs, and implementation requirements.
  • Design high-density fiber architectures supporting GPU clusters, Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, storage networks, and data center interconnects.
  • Develop rack-to-rack, row, zone, meet-me-room, backbone, horizontal, and cross-connect cabling architectures.
  • Define fiber types, connectorization, polarity, patching, labeling, pathway, containment, and cable management standards.
  • Develop and validate cable matrices, port maps, connectivity schedules, rack elevations, drawings, BOMs, and installation documentation.
  • Partner with OEMs and infrastructure manufacturers to validate interoperability, standards, product selection, and technical roadmaps.
  • Support estimating, proposals, statements of work, RFQs/RFPs, technical presentations, and customer design reviews.
  • Work with Professional Services and field delivery teams to ensure designs are constructible, scalable, testable, and repeatable across large deployments.
  • Support design-to-delivery handoff, installation standards, QA/QC requirements, testing, certification, documentation, and closeout.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate fiber design, documentation, BOM creation, and deployment methodologies.

What you have

  • 5+ years of experience designing fiber, structured cabling, or physical network infrastructure in data center environments.
  • Strong background in one or more AI Data Center connectivity areas, including high-density fiber architectures, GPU cluster connectivity, Ethernet/InfiniBand fabrics, structured cabling, data center interconnect, rack-level connectivity, and large-scale fiber deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of single-mode and multimode fiber, MPO/MTP and LC connectivity, polarity methods, transceivers/optics, patching architectures, and high-density fiber management.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data centers, hyperscale environments, AI infrastructure, HPC, cloud providers, NCPs, or major colocation/data center operators is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to interpret network designs, rack elevations, port maps, equipment layouts, construction drawings, and customer technical standards.
  • Experience creating or validating BOMs, cable matrices, connectivity schedules, design packages, test requirements, and as-built documentation.
  • Knowledge of structured cabling standards, installation practices, testing/certification, labeling, pathways, and data center QA/QC processes.
  • Experience working with major networking OEMs, optics providers, fiber manufacturers, and structured cabling partners.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, technical presentation, documentation, and design-review skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, project management, operations, field delivery, and partner organizations.
  • Ability to operate in fast-moving environments where designs and deployment requirements evolve rapidly.
  • AI infrastructure and large GPU clusters
  • 400G, 800G, and emerging high-speed data center connectivity
  • High-performance Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics
  • Hyperscale or cloud data center fiber architecture
  • High-density rack and row-level connectivity
  • Large-scale fiber installation and patching programs
  • Pre-terminated and modular fiber solutions
  • Offsite fiber preparation, kitting, labeling, and pre-integration
  • Fiber testing, certification, troubleshooting, and remediation
  • Automated cable matrices, BOMs, port mapping, and design documentation
  • Multi-site deployment standards and repeatable data center design methodologies
  • Fiber Architecture – Deep understanding of high-density data center fiber design and physical connectivity.
  • AI Infrastructure Knowledge – Understands how GPU compute, networking, storage, and rack architectures drive physical layer requirements.
  • Design at Scale – Creates repeatable architectures capable of supporting thousands of racks and very large connection counts.
  • Technical Accuracy – Maintains rigorous attention to port mapping, polarity, labeling, testing, documentation, and quality.
  • Customer Engagement – Can lead technical discovery, design workshops, and customer architecture reviews.
  • Design-to-Delivery Thinking – Develops solutions that can be efficiently sourced, pre-built, installed, tested, and operated.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Connects customer requirements with sales, engineering, sourcing, partners, and field delivery.
  • Quality and accuracy of fiber and structured cabling designs
  • Speed from customer requirements to executable solution architecture
  • Design standardization and repeatability across AI Data Center programs
  • Reduction of field changes, rework, and connectivity defects
  • Successful technical support of pipeline and customer pursuits
  • Accuracy of BOMs, cable matrices, port maps, and design documentation
  • Successful transition from solution architecture into deployment
  • Customer satisfaction and technical credibility

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data center fiber architect who understands how to turn complex AI infrastructure and network requirements into highly accurate, scalable physical connectivity solutions. They should be comfortable working from GPU and network architecture down to the rack, port, optic, fiber, connector, pathway, and patching level. This individual should combine strong technical depth with practical deployment experience—someone who can design for scale while understanding how the solution will actually be sourced, staged, installed, tested, documented, and supported in a high-velocity AI Data Center environment.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

jobs.title: AI Resilience Partner
jobs.excerpt: EQL Tech is partnered with Convergent Research in the search for an outstanding AI Resilience Partner.
jobs.description:
EQL Tech is partnered with Convergent Research in the search for an outstanding AI Resilience Partner. Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): purpose-built, mission-driven orgs designed to solve technological bottlenecks, unlock whole new fields, and lead to scaled revolutions. We’ve proven our model works by building over 14 high-impact scientific organizations spanning AI (here), biotech, mathematics, climate science, and more.

AI capability is compounding faster than the world's ability to absorb it. Other technologies got decades to sort out their safety codes, their testing regimes, and the institutions that enforce them. We don't have decades. The defenses have to be built while the technology is still moving, and there's no budget line anywhere that says build the defenses now.

That's the gap this role exists to close. Not "how do we build another AI company" — plenty of people are doing that. This role is about building the missing institutions and technical infrastructure that make the world resilient to advanced AI: the defensive capabilities that won't be built by a startup, won't fit inside an academic lab, and are too important to leave to chance.

What you’ll do

Partners at Convergent are like senior partners at a venture incubator. You'll create and fully own a growing portfolio of FROs and other scientific projects that advance AI resilience — society's capacity to capture AI's benefits while withstanding its risks.

The portfolio is yours to define, but the surface area is much bigger than model safety alone. It spans defensive biosecurity (pathogen-agnostic detection, next-generation PPE, rapid countermeasures), provably secure cyber-physical systems and formal verification, epistemic infrastructure for a world flooded with AI-generated content, independent evaluation and monitoring capacity, compute governance, economic modeling of the transition — and areas nobody has named yet. The unifying question: what keystone defensive capability, if it existed, would make the world meaningfully harder to break?

You will have extreme latitude to decide what your portfolio should include, and the resources to go build it.

You’ll form strong theses, find extraordinary founders, pressure-test ideas, raise money, build boards, launch organizations, and help them move with the speed and focus of the best deep-tech startups.

Specifically, you will:

  • Roadmap the AI resilience landscape to identify the bottlenecks and keystone capabilities worth building organizations around
  • Source and diligence ideas for new projects and organizations and design funding calls in partnership with funders
  • Build founding teams and help recruit the early hires who will make or break them
  • Directly contribute to and coach founders on technical and organizational roadmaps, fundraising, and standing up startup ops from zero
  • Serve as a Director on multiple FRO boards, keeping teams on track against milestones and helping founders make the genuinely hard calls on funding, strategic direction, hiring, firing, and operations
  • Represent Convergent externally, building high-trust relationships with the philanthropic and public funders now committing serious capital to AI resilience
  • Contribute to Convergent-wide initiatives like our Founder Retreats and Residencies

Requirements

Who you are

  • You understand the AI landscape of 2026 in granular detail: who is building what, why, and on what timeline
  • More importantly, you have a view on where that leaves the rest of the world exposed, and which of those exposures are tractable and through what clever ideas and technical methods they might be patchable, and who are the people developing those ideas
  • You have ideas, or a credible plan to find ideas, for large-scale efforts that would measurably improve how the world weathers this transition
  • You can argue passionately for a thesis about where philanthropic capital should go, and then argue the other side just as well
  • You're technically fluent in frontier AI, enough to tell a real bottleneck from a fashionable one
  • You have a deep network in the field and people pick up when you call
  • You know how startups actually work, probably because you’ve worked at one, or at a venture firm, or built something yourself
  • You’ve raised money, owned a budget, written technical roadmaps, and hired people
  • You’ve assembled a group of people to do a hard technical thing, and it worked
  • You’ve spent time around boards, governance, or nonprofit leadership
  • You communicate clearly and you move fast

It’s okay if you don’t meet every single criterion above perfectly.If you've read this far, and you're already sketching the organization you'd build first, we want to hear from you.

Benefits

What you’ll get

  • A rare chance to build institutional architecture for frontier science alongside some of the sharpest people working across a dozen fields
  • Competitive salary, with a range of $200,000 - $350,000.
  • Up to a 6% 401k match because future-you deserves comfort
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance—majority of options are fully covered for you and your dependents. Stay healthy, my friend
  • Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as voluntary supplemental insurance options
  • 19 holidays (including a full week off at the end of the year—yes, we enforce it)
  • 3 weeks PTO with tenure increases, with separate allotments for sick and parental leave
  • Generous fertility benefits and childcare reimbursement—because tiny humans are a big deal
  • Education and professional development benefits
  • Wellness allowance for fitness and wellness activities (treat yourself to climbing shoes or Calm.com—no judgment)
  • 3x/year offsite team retreats and additional opportunities to meet your teammates in person

  • Collect, organize, review, and reconcile supporting documentation such as invoices, contracts, purchase orders, force-account labor, equipment usage, materials, mutual aid, insurance information, and proof of payment.

jobs.title: Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: JOB OVERVIEWDeliverHealth is seeking an experienced Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist to support the continuous improvement of InstaNote's AI-powered Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) feature.
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

DeliverHealth is seeking an experienced Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Specialist to support the continuous improvement of InstaNote's AI-powered Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) feature.

The primary responsibility of this role is to evaluate the quality, clinical relevance, and accuracy of the CDI recommendations generated by InstaNote during patient encounters. The specialist will validate AI-generated suggestions, identify false positives, false negatives, and missed documentation opportunities, and provide structured feedback to Product Management and Engineering teams to continuously enhance the performance of the CDI engine.

This is not a traditional operational CDI role focused on physician queries or concurrent hospital documentation reviews. Instead, this is a Product Quality and Clinical AIrole that ensures InstaNote delivers clinically meaningful, accurate, and actionable documentation improvement recommendations.

This role serves as the critical link between clinical expertise, revenue cycle knowledge, and AI product development.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Validate AI-Generated CDI Recommendations

Review and validate CDI recommendations generated by InstaNote, including:

  • Missing diagnoses

  • Diagnosis specificity

  • HCC and Risk Adjustment opportunities

  • CC/MCC opportunities

  • Medical necessity documentation

  • Procedure documentation

  • Severity of Illness (SOI)

  • Risk of Mortality (ROM)

  • Missing clinical details

  • Documentation clarification opportunities

  • Quality measure documentation

  • Chronic condition documentation

  • Medication-related documentation opportunities

For each recommendation, determine whether it is:

  • Clinically accurate

  • Relevant to the encounter

  • Supported by documentation

  • Actionable for the provider

  • High value from a coding and reimbursement perspective

2. Review AI-Generated Clinical Notes

Evaluate clinical notes generated by InstaNote to determine whether:

  • Important diagnoses are missing

  • Documentation lacks clinical specificity

  • Medical decision-making is adequately represented

  • History, assessment, and plan support the documented diagnoses

  • Clinical evidence aligns with suggested CDI opportunities

Identify documentation gaps that the AI failed to recognize.

3. Perform AI Quality Audits

Conduct routine audits of the CDI feature by measuring:

  • Recommendation accuracy

  • Precision

  • Recall

  • False positive rate

  • False negative rate

  • Missed documentation opportunities

  • Clinical relevance

  • Specialty appropriateness

  • Provider usability

  • Recommendation acceptance potential

Document findings in standardized quality scorecards.

4. Continuous Product Improvement

Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering teams by providing structured feedback on:

  • Incorrect recommendations

  • Missing clinical logic

  • New documentation scenarios

  • Specialty-specific documentation patterns

  • Prompt improvements

  • Knowledge gaps

  • AI workflow enhancements

  • User experience improvements

  • Recommendation prioritization

Participate in regular AI quality review sessions to prioritize enhancements.

5. Build Clinical Knowledge Assets

Support AI model development by creating and maintaining:

  • Gold-standard annotated clinical cases

  • Specialty-specific documentation examples

  • Accepted and rejected recommendation libraries

  • Clinical review guidelines

  • Evaluation datasets for regression testing

  • Reference documentation standards

6. Specialty-Specific Optimization

Review CDI recommendations across specialties such as:

  • Orthopedics

  • Emergency Medicine

  • Urgent Care

  • Primary Care

  • Cardiology

  • Internal Medicine

  • Behavioral Health

  • Pediatrics

  • Surgical Specialties

Recommend specialty-specific enhancements to improve AI performance.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with:

  • Product Managers

  • AI Engineers

  • Prompt Engineers

  • Machine Learning Engineers

  • Medical Coders

  • Clinical Informaticists

  • QA Engineers

  • Data Scientists

Translate clinical observations into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria.

Key Deliverables

  • Weekly AI CDI validation reports

  • Clinical quality scorecards

  • False positive and false negative analyses

  • Missed opportunity reports

  • Root cause analyses

  • Product enhancement recommendations

  • Annotated reference cases

  • Specialty-specific feedback reports

  • Monthly AI performance trend reports

  • Clinical acceptance criteria for new CDI features

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

  • Clinical Documentation Improvement

  • ICD-10-CM

  • HCC Risk Adjustment

  • CPT coding fundamentals

  • Documentation specificity

  • Medical necessity

  • Clinical terminology

  • Provider documentation workflows

  • AI-assisted documentation tools

  • Electronic Health Records (Epic, athenahealth, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, etc.)

Core Competencies

  • Strong clinical judgment
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to identify documentation gaps
  • Root cause analysis
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Effective written communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Passion for healthcare AI and clinical innovation

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Health Information Management, Medicine, Physician Assistant Studies, or a related clinical field.
  • 5+ years of Clinical Documentation Improvement experience.
  • Experience reviewing physician documentation for coding quality and documentation completeness.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding principles.
  • Experience with HCC and Risk Adjustment documentation.
  • Familiarity with outpatient and ambulatory documentation practices.
  • Experience working with physicians on documentation quality initiatives.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to AI-assisted clinical documentation solutions is preferred.
  • Preferred credentials include:
  • RN / BSN
  • RHIA
  • RHIT
  • PA
  • NP
  • MD / DO (preferred but not required)

Overview

Consilio is seeking a Senior Legal Engineer – AI Solutions & Workflows to help design the next generation of AI-enabled legal services and workflows across the organization.

This role will sit at the intersection of legal practice, generative AI, workflow design, data, and service delivery. The successful candidate will be a hands-on builder who understands how legal professionals work and can translate legal and business problems into practical AI-enabled workflows using platforms such as Claude, Harvey and other enterprise generative AI technologies, together with Consilio's proprietary technology and legal data capabilities.

The role will be central to Consilio's enterprise AI strategy, working across eDiscovery, investigations, legal operations, managed services, Lawyers on Demand, product, innovation and client teams. Depending on the experience and leadership capabilities of the successful candidate, the position may also evolve into broader leadership responsibility for Consilio's AI Solutions & Workflow function.

Responsibilities

  • Design AI-enabled legal workflows that combine generative AI, legal data, Consilio technology, third-party platforms, process design and human expertise to improve legal outcomes.
  • Serve as a hands-on legal engineer, developing prompts, agent instructions, workflows, prototypes and multi-step agentic processes using Claude, Harvey and similar enterprise AI platforms.
  • Work directly with lawyers, litigation teams, legal operations professionals and Consilio subject-matter experts to understand legal tasks and convert them into structured, repeatable AI workflows.
  • Design workflows that intelligently combine AI with human review and validation, including appropriate checkpoints, escalation criteria and quality controls.
  • Develop solutions that may span Consilio's proprietary AI capabilities, client-approved enterprise AI platforms, review technologies, APIs, MCP/connectors and other legal technology.
  • Prototype new approaches rapidly, test them against real legal use cases and determine whether they should become a repeatable service, product capability, connected solution or further innovation initiative.
  • Partner with Consilio Product and Technology teams to translate workflow requirements into product capabilities and integrations.
  • Partner with AI LegalWorks, Lawyers on Demand and delivery organizations to turn successful designs into scalable managed services and AI-enabled operating models.
  • Help establish reusable workflow patterns, agent architectures, prompt libraries, evaluation methods and implementation playbooks that can be applied across clients and matters.
  • Develop testing and validation frameworks to assess output quality, reliability, defensibility and appropriate human oversight before workflows are scaled.
  • Support selected client engagements, workshops and solution-design sessions, particularly where sophisticated AI workflow expertise is required.
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, platforms and agentic technologies based on their practical applicability to legal work rather than technology novelty alone.
  • Help educate Consilio teams on effective use of generative AI and how emerging capabilities can be applied to real legal workflows.
  • Contribute to broader decisions regarding when Consilio should build, connect, partner, operationalize or incubate an AI capability.

Qualifications

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines meaningful legal-domain understanding with unusual technical curiosity and hands-on experience using modern generative AI.

They should be comfortable moving between a conversation with a senior lawyer about an investigation or legal process and a working session designing the prompts, tools, data sources and agent steps required to improve that process.

Preferred Experience & Capabilities

  • Significant experience working within legal services, a law firm, corporate legal department, legal technology company, ALSP or legal innovation function.
  • Strong understanding of legal workflows, ideally including litigation, investigations, eDiscovery, legal operations, contract workflows or other high-volume legal processes.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Claude, Harvey or comparable enterprise generative AI platforms.
  • Experience designing sophisticated prompts, reusable workflows, AI assistants, agents or multi-step generative-AI processes.
  • Understanding of agentic AI concepts, including tool use, workflow decomposition, retrieval, context management, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop controls and multi-step reasoning.
  • Ability to determine when a task is best handled through generative AI versus traditional search, analytics, deterministic automation or human legal judgment.
  • Familiarity with APIs, MCP, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise data connections or similar integration concepts is strongly preferred; deep software-engineering expertise is not necessarily required.
  • Ability to prototype solutions independently and work effectively with engineers when production development is required.
  • Strong analytical and process-design skills with an ability to break complex legal work into discrete tasks, decision points and repeatable workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and credibility working with lawyers, technologists, business leaders and clients.
  • Practical orientation toward measurable outcomes, adoption and scalability, rather than experimentation for its own sake.

Particularly Valuable Backgrounds

We recognize that this capability may come from a variety of backgrounds. Strong candidates may include practicing or former attorneys who have become sophisticated AI builders, legal innovation or knowledge-management professionals, legal technologists, legal operations professionals, eDiscovery practitioners with strong generative-AI expertise, or technically oriented consultants who deeply understand legal workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means moving Consilio from individual AI tools and isolated use cases toward repeatable AI-enabled legal workflows that can be delivered consistently across clients and business lines.

Within the first year, the successful candidate should help Consilio:

  • Establish a portfolio of validated AI-enabled workflow patterns.
  • Develop sophisticated agentic workflows around priority legal use cases.
  • Translate successful prototypes into scalable services and product requirements.
  • Increase the effective use of both Consilio and third-party AI technologies.
  • Reduce dependence on one-off expert intervention.
  • Demonstrate measurable improvements in speed, capacity, cost, quality or legal-team effectiveness.

Potential Role Evolution

The role should be structured as a senior hands-on legal engineering position first. For the right candidate, it could evolve into broader leadership responsibility for Consilio's AI Solutions & Workflow function as the program matures.

• Agility

We flex, adapt, and embrace change

• People

We create clarity of purpose and a clear path forward

Better Impact is hiring an Account Executive to help carry our next phase of growth. This role will report directly to the VP of Sales.

This is a full-cycle, demo-driven closing role. You will run prospecting, discovery, demo, handle objections, negotiate, and close, primarily with volunteer program leaders at nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, and volunteer centers.

The company has strong fundamentals: a large market, a proven demo-to-close motion, and leadership that is actively investing in the tools, training, and pricing structure that make it easier for you to win. We need AEs who can execute a proven process at volume today, and who want to grow with a team that is actively getting more disciplined, better resourced, and better enabled as it scales.

You will own your full pipeline: qualifying and running demos on inbound, SDR-sourced, and (increasingly) self-sourced leads, managing forecast and deal hygiene in HubSpot, and closing new business against a defined ACV and deal-volume target. You will work closely with your SDR or BDR team members, your VP of Sales, and Customer Success on handoff and onboarding.

What you will do

  • Run a full-cycle sales process from discovery through close: qualify inbound and SDR-set demos, lead a consultative, value-first demo, handle pricing conversations and objections, and close.
  • Build roughly 30% of your opportunity pipeline using outbound campaigns that incorporate calling, emailing and social (LinkedIn) strategies
  • Carry and hit a monthly quota built on ACV and closed-deal volume, with a clear weekly pipeline review and forecast cadence.
  • Build and protect a healthy pipeline, including a self-sourced component through outbound prospecting, sequence follow-up, and reengagement of past closed-lost opportunities.
  • Run demos and discovery from the volunteer's point of view first, not just the administrator's, using Better Impact's established demo methodology and closing checklist.
  • Use discovery to surface the prospect's own urgency rather than manufacturing it, and apply approved urgency and pricing frameworks consistently rather than improvising deal-by-deal.
  • Keep HubSpot pipeline data accurate and current: deal stage, next steps, decision maker and budget holder, and close date, so your forecast can be trusted.
  • Partner with your SDR/BDR and with Customer Success on clean handoffs, so new customers start onboarding with the right expectations and the right contacts.
  • Stay current on product, pricing, and competitive positioning as Better Impact modernizes its platform and pricing structure, and bring field feedback back to the team.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle, closing sales experience, ideally in SaaS or software, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience building and running your own outbound sequences (Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar) alongside inbound demo volume.
  • Comfort running a high-volume, demo-driven sales motion: this is a high-activity role with real deal velocity, not a long, low-volume enterprise cycle.
  • Strong discovery and objection-handling skills, with the ability to sell value and outcomes to a buyer who is not evaluating you on technology for its own sake.
  • Experience or genuine comfort selling to mission-driven, budget-conscious buyers (nonprofits, government, healthcare, education), including the ability to build urgency and justify price without becoming transactional.
  • Disciplined pipeline and CRM hygiene: accurate, current HubSpot data, reliable forecasting, and follow-through on next steps.
  • Coachability: a real track record of taking structured coaching (call reviews, scorecards, scripting) and visibly improving from it.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable presenting to both a single volunteer coordinator and, on larger deals, a broader buying committee.
  • Resilience and self-direction in a fast-changing environment: pricing, packaging, and process are actively evolving here, and you'll be expected to adapt quickly rather than wait for a finished playbook.

Strong pluses

These are not required, but they would help you ramp quickly:

  • Experience selling into nonprofits, volunteer programs, healthcare systems, higher education, or government/municipal buyers.
  • Experience with volunteer management, case management, CSR/ESG, or other mission-driven or compliance-adjacent SaaS categories.
  • Experience selling through a merger or major pricing/packaging change, and staying productive through that kind of transition.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot as a sales CRM.
  • Experience with a structured sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Sandler or similar) and comfort working from a defined closing checklist rather than an unstructured pitch.

Benefits

As part of our commitment to supporting you in both your professional and personal life, we offer a comprehensive range of employee benefit programs, including:

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission
  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • 401(k) program with an employer match (after 90 days)
