Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

This opportunity is exclusively available as a B2B arrangement

As a Product Owner at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

  • Polish language skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.

Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both a monthly fee and equity in Chooose.

At Alteryx, we're putting data + AI to work for the Intelligent Enterprise — and our customers are at the heart of that story. Our success is measured by theirs, and we're looking for a Customer Advocacy Manager to bring that to life: running a program that celebrates our best customers, puts their voices front and center, and turns their success into stories that inspire the market and prove what's possible with Alteryx. This is a chance to own an established program and help shape its next chapter — part community builder, part storyteller, part connector — with real visibility across Sales, Product Marketing, and company events.

Build better healthcare together

Maple’s purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We’re Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we’re proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what’s possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you’ll do work that changes lives—including your own.

The role

    We're looking for our next cohort of Bilingual Lab and Referral Operations Coordinators (French/English) to join our Care Delivery Operations team. This is a role where the details matter—where your precision, reliability and follow-through directly support the clinicians, patients and partners who depend on us every day.

    In this role, you'll own the day-to-day administrative workflows that keep lab and referral processes running smoothly—reviewing, processing and routing documentation, making sure nothing gets missed and everything meets our privacy and quality standards. Key to success will be your technical confidence, sharp organizational instincts, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively—all while managing multiple priorities without losing accuracy in a fast-paced environment.

    Please note this is a fully administrative role—medical or clinical experience isn't required, though prior admin work in a healthcare setting is an asset. This isn't a lab-based position; Maple is a virtual platform connecting patients with doctors and nurse practitioners.

Your responsibilities

    As a Bilingual Lab and Referral Operations Coordinator (French/English), you will:

  • Take ownership of a high volume of incoming lab and referral documentation—faxes, voicemails and digital records—processing and managing each one in line with Maple's privacy and security standards

  • Upload, route and track lab results and referral information so clinicians can review and follow up without delay

  • Respond to urgent lab communications and escalate critical results quickly—because getting it right the first time supports patient safety

  • Dig into missing, incomplete or unclear documentation and coordinate with labs, clinics and internal teams to get it resolved

  • Keep patient records accurate and ensure everything lines up between patient information and lab or referral data

  • Support public health reporting and compliance-related documentation as required

  • Work closely with Customer Support and Care Delivery teams to address lab- and referral-related questions from patients and providers

  • Hold the bar high—consistently meeting accuracy, quality and turnaround expectations to keep care delivery running at its best

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.

This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

  • Design, build, and maintain resilient frontend and backend features using React and Node.js.
  • Develop our core products, including donation checkouts, embeddable widgets, and donor/partner portals.
  • Architect and develop system components that scale across millions of monthly transactions.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable code.
  • Drive architecture and technical design discussions to find elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Mentor peers by conducting thoughtful code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Partner with product managers and designers to clarify requirements and shape the roadmap.

  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. About Hunger Free America:

Hunger Free America (HFA), founded in 1983 as the New York City Coalition Against Hunger, is a dynamic and highly effective national anti-hunger advocacy and direct service organization that is based in New York City but works in all 50 states. The Nation has written that the organization has grown into “one of the leading direct service and advocacy organizations on hunger and poverty in the nation.” Our mission is to build a nonpartisan, grassroots movement to enact the public policies and programs needed to end domestic hunger and ensure that all Americans have sufficient access to nutritious food.
Our long-term goal is not just to ameliorate the problem, but also to build the people’s movement necessary to enact the economic and public policies needed to end hunger entirely. Given that hunger drains our economy and tears at our moral and civic fabric, we know that eliminating it will boost the nation both economically and spiritually. Towards that end, we have adopted the motto: “Ending hunger lifts us all.”

About the Associate Board:

HFA is seeking dedicated and qualified candidates who are passionate about ending hunger in the U.S. to serve on our Associate Board. As an associate board member, you will play a vital role in supporting our organization’s efforts through organizing and hosting fundraising events, elevating the profile of HFA’s work, and by actively participating in learning opportunities related to nonprofit development.
This is an exciting opportunity for an early or mid-career professional to make a significant impact on the lives of vulnerable individuals and families experiencing hunger nationwide. The Associate Board will work in partnership with our Board of Directors.
Volunteer role: This is an unpaid, volunteer position without any financial compensation or benefits.

Responsibilities & Expectations:

  • Term: Associate board positions are held for one, two-year term with the option for an extension based on forthcoming governance by-laws.
  • Fundraising Events: Collaborate with the Development Team and staff to plan, organize, and execute fundraising events throughout the year aimed at generating funds for HFA’s programs. Utilize creativity and innovation to attract donors, sponsors, and community participants.
  • Donor Cultivation: Assist in identifying potential donors and sponsors for events, programs, and ongoing support. Contribute to nurturing relationships with donors and supporters in collaboration with the Development Department.
  • Networking and Outreach: Engage with community leaders, local businesses, and other potential partners to build awareness of HFA's mission and expand the network of supporters.
  • Committee Participation: Contribute actively to committees/working groups focused on specific initiatives, such as governance, event planning, marketing, volunteer recruitment, or strategic planning.
  • Advocacy and Awareness: Support the organization's advocacy efforts by sharing information about food insecurity issues and the importance of anti-hunger initiatives on social media and within personal networks.
  • Financial Contributions: Associate board members have a $500 a year give/get.
  • Board Meetings and Participation: Attend quarterly board and committee meetings regularly and actively participate in discussions and decision-making processes. 
  • Nonprofit Development: Enthusiasm for learning about nonprofit development, management, and governance. Stay informed about best practices and industry trends, and bring new ideas and insights to the board to enhance the HFA's effectiveness.

Qualifications:

  • Strong passion for addressing hunger and food insecurity issues in New York City and nationwide.
  • Active in their community with strong peer network, strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders and potential donors; eager to fundraise in their social and professional circles.
  • A strong track record of volunteer experience (nonprofit or otherwise) and/or experience with nonprofits is required; prior board experience is a plus but not required.
  • Prior experience in fundraising and/or event planning is preferred but not mandatory. Willingness to learn and actively participate in fundraising efforts is essential.
  • Lived experience with hunger is a plus.
  • Proximity to New York City is a plus for in-person engagement, but not required.

How to Apply:

  • A current resume and short written answers to questions are required. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until all board positions are filled. A cover letter is not required. Please focus on the short answer questions.
  • Send your resume and responses to the four short answer questions to HFA Chief Development Officer Betty Ortiz at  and Associate Board Chair Chloe Magnuson at the subject line "Application for the Associate Board."

  • Why do you want to be a member of Hunger Free America’s Associate Board?

  • Fundraising is an important part of a board member’s responsibilities. Pitch us a creative idea for an in-person or virtual event with a goal of raising $5,000 that you would be interested in working on with board members.

  • Perform baseline accessibility audits of existing courses where no prior audit or conformance report exists.

Role overview

Owns Kraymer Art's influencer and creator program end to end, from sourcing creators through briefing, content, usage rights, and reporting. Turns a warm anime audience into a repeatable content and demand channel. Partnerships sequence behind product launches, so launch timing drives who we work with and what they make. Works closely with the founder and marketing to move strong creator content into organic, paid, and long-term brand relationships.

What you'll do

  • Own the influencer and creator program end to end, sourcing through content delivery and reporting.
  • Source and qualify anime, gaming, fashion, and lifestyle creators by brand fit, audience, engagement, and content quality.
  • Negotiate partnerships, rates, deliverables, timelines, and usage rights. Keep every agreement clear and in writing.
  • Brief creators against each product launch so content lands on schedule and on message.
  • Run gifting and seeding programs and manage ongoing creator relationships without letting them slip.
  • Review creator content for brand fit and quality before it goes live. Hold the standard.
  • Turn strong creator content into paid opportunities, including whitelisting and partnership ads on Meta and TikTok.
  • Build and maintain the creator database, outreach templates, briefs, and performance reporting.
  • Build an ongoing ambassador roster of repeat partners, including referrals from creators we already trust.

Must-haves

  • Proven influencer or creator marketing experience, with a program you personally ran for an ecommerce brand.
  • Hands-on experience negotiating deals and managing deliverables, timelines, and usage rights.
  • Experience turning creator content into paid ads through whitelisting or partnership ads, such as Meta partnership ads or TikTok Spark Ads.
  • Comfortable with an influencer CRM, outreach, or campaign tracking tool such as GRIN, Social Snowball, or a comparable platform.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Genuine anime knowledge and familiarity with fandom communities.
  • Written and spoken English at C2 level. This is a hard requirement.

Nice to have

  • Experience with tracked links and discount codes for measuring creator performance.
  • A network of anime, gaming, or collector creators you can activate quickly.
  • Comfort reading performance data and adjusting who you work with based on results.

The details

  • Fully remote, open to applicants in any country.
  • 40 hours per week, flexible hours, choose your own schedule.
  • Pay is US$6 to US$15 per hour based on experience. If your rate expectation is above this range, this is not the role for you. Please do not apply.
  • Long-term role with full-time potential.

How to apply

If this fits your experience and the pay band works for you, apply. To help us find thoughtful applicants, please write the word "seesaw" in your response to the first screening question on the application page.

jobs.description:
We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.
We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.

Role Summary

The Senior Payment Operations Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of payment operations processes, ensuring compliance with service level agreements and supporting the integrity of financial transactions across the organization. This role partners closely with Product and Technology teams to drive platform stability and enhancement.

Key Responsibilities

    • Manage, monitor, and ensure all payment processing meets established SLAs for timeliness and accuracy
    • Triage and resolve payment exceptions, including items in manual review queues
    • Perform daily and monthly reconciliation of payment accounts
    • Ensure all payment activities adhere to regulatory and internal compliance guidelines, including NACHA rules, HIPAA requirements, and company-specific controls
    • Investigate and resolve discrepancies across multiple systems (payment gateways, ledgering platforms, claims processing systems)
    • Conduct production verification following releases
    • Prepare operational reports on payment volumes, exception rates, and reconciliation status to internal stakeholders
    • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to identify platform defects, define operational requirements, and validate enhancements that improve reliability and efficiency
    • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Engineering, Compliance) to resolve escalated payment issues
    • Maintain and follow standard operating procedures; recommend process improvements where appropriate
    • Assist with audit support by providing documentation and transaction-level detail as needed

jobs.description:
All Heart Home Care Agency is seeking a per diem Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW) or Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) to support our NYC Human Resources Administration (HRA) home care program, with a focus on Emergency and Exceptional Home Attendant Services (also known as “Difficult to Serve” or DTS cases). This role provides psychosocial support and coordination for clients with complex medical, psychosocial, environmental, and family circumstances, and works closely with home attendants, agency staff, and outside case management entities to keep clients safely and successfully served in their own homes.

This is a remote position. Candidates must hold an active, unrestricted New York State social work license (LMSW or LCSW) and registration, but do not need to reside in New York State — we welcome applicants located anywhere, provided they are able to meet the licensure and authorization requirements described below.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide psychosocial assessment and ongoing support for DTS/“difficult to serve” clients whose needs involve psychosocial, environmental, and/or family complexity.
  • Provide ongoing training, guidance, and intensive support to home attendants and housekeepers assigned to complex cases, to help them sustain consistent, quality care.
  • Coordinate with and make timely referrals to the appropriate case management entities (e.g., managed care plans, CASA offices, community-based services) to stabilize clients and connect them with needed resources.
  • Support efforts to reduce home attendant turnover and case attrition on complex cases through responsive, ongoing engagement.
  • Participate in identifying and addressing risk factors, including safety concerns, changes in client condition, and potential abuse/neglect situations, escalating promptly per agency and DSS/HRA protocols.
  • Maintain accurate, timely case documentation consistent with agency, HRA, and NYS DOH standards.
  • Collaborate with the nursing staff and administrative team as part of the interdisciplinary care approach for assigned cases.
  • Support the agency’s Quality Assessment and Improvement Program by contributing to case reviews and service-delivery quality efforts as needed.
  • Maintain client confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, agency policy, and the NASW Code of Ethics in all interactions, including telepractice encounters.

Requirements & Qualifications
  • Active, unrestricted New York State license and registration as an LMSW or LCSW (required).
  • Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) from a program accredited by the Council on Social Work Education.
  • Experience with home care, Medicaid-funded personal care services, aging/frail elderly, and/or physically disabled populations preferred.
  • Comfort and demonstrated competence conducting assessments and support sessions via telephone and video, including managing confidentiality, technology access barriers, and emergency situations remotely.
  • Reliable, private workspace with secure high-speed internet and a HIPAA-compliant device/setup for all client-related communication and documentation.
  • If residing outside New York State: candidate must independently confirm and attest, prior to starting, that providing telehealth/telepractice social work services to New York-based clients from their state of residence does not require a separate license or authorization in that state. Proof of NY licensure alone does not satisfy this requirement, and the agency will request a signed attestation as part of onboarding.
  • Bilingual or multilingual candidates (Spanish, Russian, Haitian Creole) are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check and provide employment eligibility documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to work with interpreter/language line services for clients with limited English proficiency.

jobs.description:
Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 8 million downloads and a 4.7 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.
We’re looking for an experienced iOS developer who thrives on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who can not only deliver high-quality code today but also foresee how decisions made now will impact our app in the months and years ahead—technically, strategically, and financially.
If you excel at structured, autonomous work, understand the importance of monetization, and want to build features used by millions, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Role

  • Own the iOS codebase—maintain, optimize, and ensure it’s future-proof.
  • Develop and test features that enhance the Arise app experience.
  • Anticipate potential technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
  • Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
  • Align with Android developers to ensure cross-platform consistency, when the time comes.
  • Support monetization strategies by integrating features with measurable business impact.

Requirements

  • Middle 2+ Level Developer with proven track record.
  • Minimum 4 years of iOS development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working fully in English.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Swift.
  • Experience with Cocoapods and Fastlane.
  • Solid understanding of Apple design principles, patterns, and best practices.
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

  • High autonomy: own your work from idea to release.
  • Clear decision-making with minimal bureaucracy—no “meetings that should have been emails.”
  • Work with the newest hardware and technologies.
  • Complimentary Claude Max subscription.
  • Flexible, remote-first role (full-time).
  • Paid annual leave.
  • Direct collaboration with founders and management—your work will have visible impact.

How to Apply

Send us your application including:

  • Your CV
  • A history of your developed iOS apps
  • Salary expectations
  • (Optional) Code samples or GitHub repositories

Help us build and refine a product that runs like a well-oiled machine—and improves millions of lives in the process.

jobs.title: REMOTE - Compliance Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: About World Business Lenders (www. wbl. com) World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate–collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses across the United States that do not have access to traditional financing.
jobs.description:
About World Business Lenders (www.wbl.com)

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate–collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses across the United States that do not have access to traditional financing. The company also services its own loan portfolio and those of third parties, with a focus on managing non-performing loan pools and REO.

  • WBL is a U.S.-based company with a fully remote workforce.
  • Working hours are 9:00am–6:00pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.
  • The role requires strong spoken and written English.
    • All resumes must be submitted in English.


Overview

  • We are seeking a Corporate Legal Compliance Team Lead to oversee regulatory compliance related to corporate operations, contract governance, and licensing requirements across U.S. federal and state frameworks. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience ensuring adherence to laws impacting corporate transactions, lending activities, and regulatory reporting obligations.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Take the lead in owning and continuously enhancing our company's compliance management framework.
  • Design, roll out, and upkeep comprehensive compliance policies and procedures that keep us ahead of the curve.
  • Create and deliver engaging compliance and risk management training programs throughout the organization.
  • Foster a robust compliance culture grounded in clear accountability and strong ethical values.
  • Develop a dynamic compliance monitoring and testing program to ensure ongoing adherence.
  • Perform thorough compliance risk assessments and spearhead effective remediation initiatives.
  • Stay informed and vigilant by researching, monitoring, and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of state-by-state legal and regulatory requirements related to lending activities, including interest rate caps, usury laws, licensing, disclosure rules, collateral limitations, and filing or notice obligations.
  • Identify necessary registrations, notices, NMLS-related actions, and other local compliance requirements, collaborating closely with internal teams to implement them smoothly.
  • Translate complex legal and regulatory mandates into clear, actionable guidance for business, operations, legal, and management teams.

Requirements

Role Requirements

  • Education:
    • A degree in Law (Juris Doctor or international equivalent, such as LLB or LLM); U.S. law school preferred.
  • Experience:
    • We're looking for someone with at least 7 years of experience in U.S. Legal and/or Compliance roles.
    • It’s important to have proven experience working with U.S. federal and state regulatory compliance, legal risk management, as well as policy development and implementation within complex organizations.
    • You’ll benefit from hands-on experience researching and applying multistate U.S. laws and regulations regarding lending, commercial finance, licensing, registrations, disclosures, interest rate limits, usury, and other related operational requirements.
    • Experience in analyzing state-specific legal requirements that impact loan products, collateral structures, governing law, and regulatory or filing obligations—and being able to translate those into clear business rules and internal guidance—is key.
    • We also highly value experience working with or preparing materials for U.S. regulatory and supervisory bodies, such as state regulators, licensing authorities, Secretaries of State, and other relevant agencies.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • A solid understanding of U.S. federal and state regulatory frameworks is essential.
  • We highly value experience in financial services, commercial lending, mortgage, consumer finance, fintech, or other industries that are closely regulated.
  • It’s great to have experience with multistate lending compliance, licensing analysis, NMLS-related reviews, state registrations, and managing local filing or notice requirements.
  • If you’ve worked on creating or maintaining state law matrices, lending charts, compliance guidance, or similar tools that help manage state-by-state legal requirements, that’s a big plus!
  • Familiarity with U.S. real estate law, secured transactions, and issues related to collateral compliance would be an added bonus.

Technical Skills Required

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Adobe Acrobat;
  • Strong legal research and regulatory analysis capabilities;
  • Experience conducting compliance monitoring, testing, and risk assessments;
  • Ability to draft policies, procedures, controls, and compliance documentation;
  • Skilled in reviewing and interpreting multi-state legal and regulatory requirements;
  • Experience preparing regulatory summaries, licensing analyses, trackers, and compliance memoranda;
  • Ability to create professional reports, presentations, and business guidance materials.


Soft Skills Required

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities;
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment;
  • Strong judgment and ability to handle confidential information professionally;
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with business teams;
  • Proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented approach to work.

Benefits

  • Enjoy Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Salary paid in USD.
  • Work comfortably 100% from home.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Serves as a hands-on technical resource responsible for engineering, implementing, optimizing, automating, and supporting enterprise data platforms and database technologies. Accountable for translating data architecture and product roadmap requirements into scalable, secure, highly available, and operationally supportable solutions across enterprise data platforms. Partners closely with the Data Platform Operations Manager to ensure platform standards, operational best practices, security requirements, governance controls, automation practices, and support processes are consistently implemented across the data platform ecosystem. Provides senior technical leadership for complex initiatives, platform modernization efforts, cloud adoption programs, performance optimization activities, operational engineering, and Level 3 production support.

Platform scope: Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, Oracle databases and Oracle-based data platforms, IBM Netezza, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric where applicable, Azure-native data services, data integration technologies, analytical platforms, enterprise reporting and BI environments, and Salesforce Data Cloud knowledge where applicable.

What you will do:

  • Design, engineer, implement, configure, and support enterprise database and cloud data platform solutions supporting operational, analytical, reporting, and data integration workloads.
  • Partner with Data Architects to translate target-state architectures, technology roadmaps, modernization initiatives, and business requirements into implementable engineering designs and operationally sustainable solutions.
  • Lead hands-on implementation and support activities across Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, and related enterprise data platforms.
  • Serve as a senior technical contributor supporting both project delivery and ongoing operational platform needs.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure, platform configurations, deployment standards, automation routines, and operational processes that improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance, and supportability.
  • Engineer database platform solutions that align with enterprise security, data governance, compliance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational standards.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, authentication methods, RBAC models, service account governance, encryption capabilities, access controls, and audit requirements.
  • Design and support highly available and resilient platform architectures including backup, recovery, replication, failover, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Provide senior-level troubleshooting and Level 3 support for complex platform incidents, performance issues, integration failures, data integrity concerns, security events, and critical production outages.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for recurring operational issues and implement permanent corrective actions to improve long-term platform stability.
  • Partner with the Data Platform Operations team to establish operational runbooks, monitoring standards, support procedures, escalation models, and automation opportunities.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance, query execution, storage utilization, warehouse consumption, platform scaling, indexing strategies, and workload management.
  • Support analytical platform workloads, reporting environments, Power BI integrations, ETL/ELT pipelines, data engineering solutions, and enterprise data consumption patterns.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, environment refreshes, cloning processes, administrative workflows, monitoring integrations, and recurring operational activities.
  • Support database deployment pipelines, CI/CD processes, release activities, change management reviews, and production readiness assessments.
  • Review solution designs, data models, engineering approaches, and platform usage patterns to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
  • Participate in technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and emerging platform assessments to support modernization and innovation initiatives.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers, database administrators, contractors, and platform support personnel.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, architecture, application development, analytics, and vendor teams to coordinate platform implementations and support activities.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives, platform modernization programs, database consolidation efforts, and data platform transformation projects.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including engineering designs, implementation guides, support procedures, platform standards, architecture diagrams, operational documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements for operational efficiency, platform architecture, automation, governance, security, performance, and cost optimization.
  • Stay current on advancements in database technologies, cloud-native data services, Snowflake capabilities, Microsoft data platforms, Oracle technologies, PostgreSQL ecosystems, Salesforce Data Cloud, and emerging data engineering practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5-7 years of experience supporting, engineering, administering, or developing enterprise database and data platform technologies.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with multiple enterprise database platforms, cloud data services, or analytical data technologies.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting production-grade data platform solutions within medium to large enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production systems with responsibilities spanning performance, availability, security, reliability, and incident response.
  • Strong technical knowledge of relational database platforms including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and cloud-native database services.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, administration, performance tuning, security, RBAC, warehouses, storage optimization, replication, and platform automation.
  • Knowledge of modern cloud data platforms including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, and data warehouse architectures.
  • Strong understanding of database internals, query tuning, indexing strategies, partitioning, storage management, statistics management, workload optimization, and performance engineering.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytical and reporting environments.
  • Understanding of data integration patterns, ETL/ELT architectures, API integration concepts, and data movement technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of data security, governance, compliance, privacy controls, auditability requirements, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Experience designing and supporting backup, recovery, replication, disaster recovery, high-availability, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues affecting databases, cloud data services, reporting platforms, analytics environments, integrations, and application systems.
  • Experience working with monitoring and observability platforms including Grafana, Azure Monitor, Snowflake monitoring capabilities, and database performance tools.
  • Understanding of DevOps and DataOps principles, including source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, configuration management, and release governance.
  • Ability to automate operational tasks using scripting languages, APIs, infrastructure automation frameworks, database-native automation tools, and cloud automation capabilities.
  • Experience supporting hybrid environments containing legacy, on-premises, hosted, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Ability to interpret architecture standards and implement engineering solutions that align with strategic technology objectives.
  • Ability to identify technical risks, operational gaps, capacity constraints, performance concerns, and supportability issues while recommending practical remediation plans.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with architects, engineers, DBAs, developers, product owners, project teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and technology leadership.
  • Ability to mentor technical team members and promote engineering excellence, operational discipline, documentation quality, and adoption of best practices.
  • Comfortable operating within Agile, DevOps, Waterfall, hybrid, and governance-driven delivery models.
  • Ability to balance project delivery responsibilities with operational support, production stability, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The extras:

  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Experience working within healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with Snowflake platform engineering and administration.
  • Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure-native data services, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Oracle database platforms, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, and SQL Server administration and engineering.
  • Experience with data warehousing, dimensional modeling, data lake architectures, ELT/ETL platforms, and modern analytics ecosystems.
  • Experience with DataOps, DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native operational practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, customer data platforms, customer identity solutions, or enterprise data activation platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or other BI environments.
  • Relevant certifications in Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, cloud engineering, data engineering, or related technologies.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

Key to success in this position is a high level of experience implementing enterprise-class CRM platforms and an understanding of the value that CRM provides to sales, marketing, finance, operations and customer service teams. In this role, we will work with you to build upon your experience and abilities and expand your areas of influence and capabilities using Creatio. The best candidates for this position “start with the end in mind” and have the ability to understand what is important to their clients , what their core needs are, and the best functional solutions and methods to exceed their requirements, goals and achieve 100% user adoption. A successful team member can understand the need, define the solution, and execute a program to make the solution a reality.

Job Responsibilities

  • Conducts analysis of client business processes and defines functional requirements. Map these objectives to Creatio’s capabilities and toolsets. Prepare appropriate documentation to communicate and validate designs with client stakeholders.
  • Help clients validate and evaluate options and prioritize potential scope based on what your client values and needs most.
  • Collaborate with team members to align on and validate project scope and the effort required to successfully implement that scope.
  • Ensure all project documentation and artifact requirements are accessible and completed timely.
  • Lead project execution from start to finish for your assigned project team.

  • Documents all project requirements as needed (user stories, system element utilization, development efforts above and beyond standard system functionality, etc.) in department-approved formats, allowing for active customer participation in the project’s deliverables and setting clear expectations on those deliverables.

Note, this is not a "programmatic" or developer role, but the ability to use native application tools to build out a final solution is key. You will be hands-on during the implementation process.
  • Lead and manage user acceptance testing cycles and conduct end user training sessions.
  • Successfully anticipate, identify and resolve issues and concerns both internally and externally to proactively ensure customer satisfaction. Professionally and proactively handle problems and/or conflict to resolution and escalate internally where appropriate.
  • Ensure client needs continue to be met throughout the customer’s lifecycle to include support requests, additional projects, etc. These needs may be ad hoc or through a structured care and maintenance program.

Job Requirements

  • 5 years implementing CRM solutions and projects. 2+ years should be in a client facing role where you defined the functional solution to be implemented.
  • Demonstratable experience with an enterprise class CRM solution such as those listed above. Experience with Creatio, Dynamics 365 Sales, or Sage CRM is preferred, but other relevant experience will be considered.
  • Certifications in any of these platforms is a strong plus and differentiator.
  • Experience with Digital marketing solutions tied to CRM is also a strong plus.
  • A strong understanding and demonstrable skill set with managing project scope, analysis & requirements definition, as well task definition within a project plan. Experience leading projects using waterfall or agile methodology are both equally relevant and desired.
  • Experience in a consulting or professional services organization is required.
  • Strong business expertise, keen understanding of CRM solutions for business needs, and an ability to align functional solutions to an organization’s needs.
  • Experience leading requirements definition and design sessions through use of interviews, surveys, user workshops, product prototype demonstrations, etc.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Competencies

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.

Compensation and Benefits

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Price Realization Strategy Manager

About the job

This is a high-impact role, critical to driving Twilio's pricing strategy and developing key pricing strategic decisions. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating Twilio's business growth while simplifying the purchasing experience for our customers.

As the Principal Price Realization Strategy Manager, you will drive the pricing strategy, analytics, and operational execution for our digital and product monetization initiatives. Reporting directly to the Director of Price Realization Strategy, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for shaping global pricing and discounting frameworks, build and design executive-facing dashboards, and optimizing revenue performance across our entire product portfolio.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Shape & Drive Pricing Strategy: Architect and execute price optimization models that accelerate business performance. You will blend price elasticity, competitive differentiation, and deep financial analysis into actionable monetization frameworks.
  • Lead PLG & Self-Service Monetization: Partner directly with Growth Marketing, Self-service Sales, Console Engineering, and Finance teams to align on product-led growth (PLG) strategies, ensuring seamless pricing execution across digital touchpoints.
  • Analytics Design: Own the design, optimization, and scaling of advanced pricing analytics dashboards (Tableau/Looker) and operational workflows. Turn complex data infrastructure into strategic tools that enhance efficiency and maximize profitability.
  • Deliver Deep-Dive Data Insights: Query and analyze complex datasets across sales, customer behavior, product usage, and financials to uncover hidden revenue opportunities, pressure-test hypotheses, and scale high-impact strategies.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as a critical bridge and internal champion across GTM Strategy, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure organizational alignment and flawless execution of new pricing initiatives.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Financial Modeling & Analytics: Hands-on mastery of developing complex pricing models and monetization frameworks, combined with 3+ years of experience building analytics dashboards in Tableau or Looker to drive strategic, revenue-optimizing decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Project Management: A proven track record of leading and delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects that generate clear, measurable business impact.

  • Global Pricing & Localization: Familiarity with navigating regional pricing dynamics, including multi-currency strategies, local market nuances, and regulatory constraints.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

We are looking for individuals like you to help us continue this momentum and bring new ideas to the table. At Delek, you will have the opportunity to make an impact and grow your career in a supportive and innovative environment.

Job Summary:

Delek US Holdings, Inc. is a diversified downstream energy company with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt, renewable fuels and convenience store retailing. We are hiring for the position of Alkylation Technology SME with the potential for site or remote work.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the corporate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation technology, providing technical leadership and support across all refining assets.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor unit performance indicators, benchmarking metrics, and technology health dashboards to identify performance gaps, reliability risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Serve as the corporate steward and technical authority for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation process safety standards, engineering best practices, and risk management strategies.
  • Own and maintain corporate alkylation technology standards, operating envelopes, critical process parameter guidance, and lessons-learned documentation to ensure consistent execution across all refining assets.
  • Provide technical consultation and troubleshooting support to refinery process engineers, production teams, and operations personnel on unit performance, process optimization, operating issues, and process safety concerns.
  • Lead efforts to improve alkylation unit safety, reliability, environmental performance, and economic optimization through application of industry best practices and sound engineering principles.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, and benchmark key alkylation performance indicators, including process safety, reliability, acid consumption, alkylate quality, equipment performance, and unit energy intensity.
  • Mentor and develop refinery process engineers, technical supervisors, and operations leaders through coaching, technical training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain corporate standards, best practices, engineering guidelines, and operating philosophies related to alkylation technology.
  • Lead the refinery alkylation best-practice network and facilitate periodic technology collaboration meetings, including agenda development, action tracking, knowledge sharing, and deployment of lessons learned.
  • Coordinate and lead annual technology health assessments for alkylation units, including performance reviews, gap identification, risk assessment, and improvement plan development.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, licensor developments, catalyst advancements, process improvements, and industry trends to identify opportunities for business improvement and competitive advantage.
  • Maintain active engagement with technology licensors, catalyst suppliers, engineering consultants, industry organizations, and peer networks to ensure awareness and application of current industry best practices and technological advancements.
  • Support process studies and technology evaluations focused on yield improvement, energy efficiency, asset utilization, environmental compliance, process safety, and profitability enhancement.
  • Provide technical leadership during unit startups, shutdowns, major operating events, turnarounds, commissioning activities, and post-startup performance stabilization efforts.
  • Participate in and provide technical leadership for process hazard analyses (PHA), layer of protection analyses (LOPA), management of change (MOC) reviews, pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), and other process safety management activities impacting alkylation units.
  • Serve as the technical authority for alkylation-related management of change reviews, significant process deviations, operating envelope exceedances, and major technology recommendations.
  • Lead or participate in incident investigations and root cause failure analyses involving process safety events, reliability incidents, environmental events, and production losses. Partner with reliability, maintenance, and operations personnel to identify corrective actions, capture lessons learned, and prevent recurrence.
  • Own and facilitate the development, maintenance, and deployment of alkylation-specific training materials, operating guidance, and competency development programs.
  • Support capital project development through concept evaluation, technology selection, design review, risk assessment, process design package review, and startup readiness activities.
  • Provide periodic updates and recommendations to refinery and corporate leadership regarding technology risks, constraints, performance gaps, improvement opportunities, and long-range strategic initiatives.
  • Exercise broad technical judgment and independent decision-making to resolve complex technical issues and influence business outcomes across multiple facilities.
  • Support other refining process technologies and business initiatives as required based on organizational needs, individual expertise, and business priorities.
  • This position relies on extensive industry experience, advanced technical knowledge, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to influence organizational decisions across multiple refining assets. A high degree of creativity, initiative, leadership, and independent decision-making is expected.

Required Qualifications – Education, Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
  • 15+ years refining experience.
  • 10+ years supporting alkylation technology.
  • Expertise in operation, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance improvement of HF and sulfuric acid alkylation units.

The Manager of Application Development owns the engineering team’s execution and the technical health, security, PCI compliance, and operational reliability of AgentMate, while partnering with Product and Delivery on approved priorities.

This is a hands-on management role for an experienced senior .NET engineer who can manage and mentor developers while remaining close to the code. The manager will translate business priorities into reliable software, help guide technical decisions, improve engineering discipline, and partner with product, delivery, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, user-focused solutions.

A primary focus of this role is to ensure that AgentMate is secure, compliant, reliable, maintainable, and operationally sound, with particular emphasis on PCI requirements, application security, vulnerability management, secure development practices, access controls, data protection, and remediation of security risks.

The manager works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, QA, Product, Delivery, and business stakeholders to ensure development activities meet established security, compliance, architectural, quality, and operational standards. The role supports product and business priorities from an engineering perspective but is not the primary owner of product strategy or roadmap direction.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the AgentMate application development team, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, security, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Plan and prioritize team capacity in partnership with product and delivery leaders; manage competing priorities, dependencies, production needs, and technical debt.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely feedback, support career development, and build succession and knowledge-sharing practices.
  • Create an inclusive, pragmatic engineering culture that values ownership, transparency, continuous learning, and measurable improvement.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance management, and resource planning for the application development team.

Hands-On Application Development

  • Remain actively involved in solution design, coding, code review, troubleshooting, and delivery for business-critical AgentMate capabilities.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain modern applications and services using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, SQL, and Azure-aligned services.
  • Guide the development of responsive, accessible user experiences using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Promote maintainable engineering patterns, appropriate reuse, automated testing, clear documentation, and clean deployment practices.
  • Diagnose complex application issues across front-end, API, service, database, integration, and hosting layers.

Application Security and Risk Management

  • Embed secure software development practices throughout requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Lead application threat modeling, secure design reviews, security-focused code reviews, and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Apply practical knowledge of OWASP application security risks, authentication and authorization, identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, dependency risk, input validation, and secure API design.
  • Partner with Information Security and infrastructure teams on vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, incident response, audit support, and security control adoption.
  • Ensure applications, libraries, and third-party components are inventoried, monitored, patched, and upgraded in a risk-based and timely manner.
  • Coach developers on defensive coding and make security expectations part of the team’s definition of done.

Delivery, Quality, and Operations

  • Own engineering execution from technical discovery through production release and ongoing support, with clear visibility into risks, decisions, and progress.
  • Improve software quality through unit, integration, regression, performance, and security testing, with automation wherever practical.
  • Establish effective code review, branching, build, deployment, release, and rollback practices within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve application observability through actionable logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for significant defects or incidents and ensure durable corrective actions are completed.
  • Balance new feature delivery with modernization, reliability, maintainability, and reduction of technical debt.

Technical Direction and Collaboration

  • Provide technical direction for the AgentMate application while operating within established enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, and technology standards.
  • Work closely with product owners, delivery managers, architects, security partners, QA, operations, and business stakeholders to shape feasible solutions and delivery plans.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain current application, integration, data-flow, deployment, and support documentation sufficient for operational continuity.
  • Evaluate new technologies and patterns based on business value, security, supportability, cost, and team readiness rather than novelty.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional application development experience, including substantial hands-on experience with Microsoft .NET technologies.
  • 2+ years of formal people leadership, engineering management, team lead, or comparable experience with responsibility for coaching and delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency with C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, SQL, object-oriented design, asynchronous programming, and modern testing practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and supporting modern web applications with React and TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated application security experience, including secure coding, threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, authentication/authorization, OWASP risks, dependency management, and secure API practices.
  • Experience with cloud-hosted applications and services, preferably Microsoft Azure, including CI/CD, monitoring, secrets/configuration management, and production support.
  • Experience integrating applications with internal and third-party services using APIs, messaging, and scheduled or event-driven processing.
  • Proven ability to lead technical delivery, make sound tradeoffs, manage risk, and communicate effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

This is a senior role responsible for the hands-on design, build, validation, and deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems at Iovance Biotherapeutics. This role is focused on execution — turning approved use cases into working, validated, production AI systems that deliver measurable business value. This role directly supports Iovance’s strategy to improve overall operational productivity. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical, hands-on senior engineer with demonstrated production experience designing and shipping Large Language Model (LLM) applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and modern AI integrations. This position works closely with IT leads, business process owners across Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Commercial, G&A, IT Security, Privacy, and Quality Assurance to deliver AI capabilities that respect Iovance’s regulated environment. This role executes against a roadmap and prioritized backlog, while contributing technical input to refinement, scoping, and sequencing.

  • Design, build, and ship AI systems against the approved Iovance AI roadmap, including end-to-end ownership of architecture, retrieval pipelines, prompts, evaluation, integrations, and deployment for assigned use cases.
